snippet.title: Nascor Descent - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Nascor Descent is a first-person dark fantasy dungeon crawler with a grim atmosphere, fast-paced combat, and meaningful choices that will affect both the story and your gameplay.

After a tragic death, you awaken in a mysterious tower that is now your purgatory. To return to life, you must find an exit in its vast labyrinth. The tower and its five realms are dangerous places filled with terrifying abominations, deadly traps, and many ways to break your mind.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4945740/Nascor_Descent/

Developer: Tiny Goblins, SaikingS
X: https://x.com/KettuGames
